title: One Piercing Note
start: Speak to Sister Catherina outside the Abbey of St. Elspeth Citharede, east of Al Kharid.

recommended.t: A form of quick transportation to Al Kharid, such as a ring of duelling, amulet of glory, Al Kharid lodestone or broomstick

rewards.t: The ability to recharge 33 Prayer points per tick while listening to a Musician (when wearing all 4 Citharede robe-pieces).

steps.t: Talk to Sister Catherina east of Al Kharid and the Desert strykewyrms. [Chat: 1 Yes! I've come to answer your prayers! › 2 Yes, I'll help you. › Accept]
Talk to Abbess Benita in the abbey, in the centre room north of the fountain. [Chat: 2 What can I do to help? › 1 Of course.]
The cells are in the southeast corner. Enter the westernmost one (Anna's cell).
Inspect the bed and window.
Go back northwest to the room west of Abbess Benita's office and inspect the beds in there for another cloth fragment.
Run directly south and inspect the body (the body is covered up in the bed in the southwesternmost room).
Question 5 people around the abbey.

sub.t: Valerio - Musician outside the abbey (3 clues). [Chat: 1 What were you singing about? › 1 You were singing about Sister Anna, weren't you? › 2 Where were you between Vespers and Compline yesterday? › 2 I can't tell you, sorry.]
Sister Elena, north of the cabbages, in the kitchen (3 clues). [Chat: 2 Where were you between Vespers and Compline yesterday? › 2 What did you think of Sister Anna? › 4 Goodbye.]

Sister Cecilia, in the east-central room, the chapel (3 clues). [Chat: 1 What are you rehearsing? › 1 No - could you tell me? › 2 Go on. › 3 Back to my other questions... › 2 Where were you between Vespers and Compline yesterday? › 4 Goodbye.]

Sister Catherina, in the chapel (2 clues). [Chat: 1 Where were you between Vespers and Compline yesterday? › 1 I'd like that. › 1 What did you think of Sister Anna? › 1 What other applicant? › 2 I can't tell you, sorry. › 3 Goodbye.]

Feet (Sister Debora, once she stands up), on the floor 3 of the clock tower on the northeast side, sticking out under the clock mechanism. Talk to her [Chat: 2 Where were you between Vespers and Compline yesterday?], then, operate the clock mechanism to show 12 o'clock. Afterwards, talk to her again (2 clues). [Chat: 1 Where were you between Vespers and Compline yesterday? › 2 Tell me about the troubadour outside. › 2 What did you think of Sister Anna? › 3 Goodbye.]

steps.t: Return to Abbess Benita, select any suspect. [Chat: 1 I've finished investigating for now. › Any]
Climb down the stairs to the cellar in the room northeast of the chapel.
Investigate the bloodstains (1 clue) and body (5 clues).
Search the robe cabinet south of Sister Elena's body. (1 clue)
Return to Abbess Benita for a cell key. [Chat: 2 I need the key to Sister Elena's cell.]
Search the sack (singular, not the sacks) in the kitchen adjacent, east of Abbess Benita.
In the southeast corner of the building, enter the second cell from the east (Elena's cell) and inspect the bed.
Read the letters, talk to Valerio the musician about Sister Elena's death (1 clue). [Chat: 1 Were you having an affair with Sister Elena? › 2 Sister Elena is dead. › Any]
Talk to Sister Cecilia in the chapel for a clue. [Chat: 2 Can you tell me exactly what happened?]
Return to Abbess Benita and blame anyone/nobody. [Chat: 1 I've finished investigating for now. › Any]
Talk to Sister Catherina, who is now dancing outside near Valerio. [Chat: 3 Alright, let's dance!]
Talk to Sister Catherina again. [Chat: 1 Abbess Benita asked me to bring you back to the abbey.] A cutscene begins.
Climb the nearby ladder (immediately south of the closed gate), operate the winch, then climb back down.

sub.t: You do not need to do this step if you skip the cutscene.

p: Abbess Benita discovers the late Sister Catherina.

steps.t: Talk to Valerio near the dead body.
Talk to Abbess Benita. [Chat: 4 (More...) › 4 (More...) › 4 I don't know who did it. › 3 We should lay a trap. › 4 A new victim. › 2 They were all associated with Valerio.]
Pick a cabbage and climb down the stairs to the cellar in the room northeast of the chapel.
Click move on the candelabrum near the eastern wall in the centre of the room north of the Reliquary, then use a cabbage on it (but don't eat it).
Search the robe cabinet, then use the robes on the cabbage-on-candelabrum.
Hide-in the cabinet [Chat: 1 Hide in the robe cabinet and wait.]. You may skip the cutscene.
Knock out the Killer, then chase after them around the abbey.
p: The Killer threatens to take Debora's life.

steps.t: Talk to the killer at the top of the tower. [Chat: Any › Any › 4 Enough talk!]
Climb down the stairs. You will get sent all the way down.
Climb up the stairs twice and operate the clock mechanism so that the minute hand points to 12.
p: Sister Anna falls off of the tower.

steps.t: Climb up the stairs and talk to the killer about the bell. [Chat: 4 Listen - is that the bell ringing?]
p: The applicant's body is laid to rest.

steps.t: Talk to Sister Debora, she'll leave. [Chat: 3 What should we do with Sister Anna?]
Talk to Sister Anna (the killer) [Chat: Any]. You may skip the cutscene.
Talk to Abbess Benita. [Chat: Any]
Quest complete!
